text:
IncidentBot: ALERT: kv-cache eviction-rate spike and continuous-batch growth detected on cluster-prod-3 (models: qwen-4-mqa, llama-3b-mqa, mistral-7b-gqa). Auto-escalation -> #incidents.

Alex: paging oncall (Alex) now — looks like prefetch multiplier + new prefix tokenization change rolled ~2h ago. p95 latency jumped 3x.

Maya: seeing steady increase in continuous_batch_size for qwen-4-mqa, trending from ~64 -> 900 in 14m. KV miss ratio also increased ~6x.

Jordan: confirming customer reports: AcmeCorp reported 15% failed requests, some 502/503s. Not widespread but multi-tenant impact on dedicated pools.

Liam: logs show repeated KV_EVICT spikes and then re-prefetch storms. Suspect prefetch threshold tuning in the autoscaler combined with tokenizer prefix folding.

Sophia: stack trace snippet from inference-runtime: 
```
2026-03-14T20:12:03Z ERROR kv_cache.go:412 evict loop: eviction_rate=0.87, in_flight_prefetch=192, continuous_batch=1024, mem_free=1.2GB
runtime: out of memory while allocating 524288000 bytes
```

Samir: oof. continuous_batch=1024 is the killer. config default cap should be 256. Who pushed the new batch-shape heuristics?

Alex: was the tokenizer change that collapsed prefixes for GQA/MQA. It increased prefix reuse metric which accidentally bumped prefetch_multiplier to 4 in the new heuristics. New heuristics merged yesterday: refs: gitlab.com/rw/runtime/heuristics@c0ffee9

Maya: quick triage plan: 1) flip prefetch_multiplier to 1 for affected model groups 2) enforce continuous_batch cap 256 3) enable kv_eviction_rate limiter 4) deploy hotfix.

Jordan: agreed. I'm taking lead on mitigation. Patching now. Will use prod-ops runbook steps.

DeployBot: CI pipeline started for branch hotfix/kv-prefetch-cap (pipeline 4782).

Jordan: running emergency patch: 
```
kubectl -n rw-runtime set env deploy/inference-runtime PREFETCH_MULTIPLIER=1 --record
kubectl -n rw-runtime patch configmap runtime-config -p '{"data":{"continuous_batch_cap":"256","kv_eviction_limiter":"enabled"}}'
```

Liam: applying throttles on qwen-4-mqa shard groups first. Mirroring change to dedicated pools.

DeployBot: rollout started: hotfix/kv-prefetch-cap -> canary on cluster-prod-3 (10% traffic). Watch p95/p99.

Sophia: metrics update: within 3m of canary, continuous_batch_size median dropped from 512 -> 80 on canary nodes. p95 latency dropped 42%. KV_EVICT_RATE decreased to baseline in canary.

Alex: good. starting progressive rollout if backend metrics hold for 10 min. Notifying customer success for AcmeCorp.

Samir: note for postmortem: root cause chain = tokenizer prefix folding + new batch-shape heuristics + prefetch_multiplier default increase -> feedback loop with KV prefetch amplifier. Make sure to add regression test for prefix-folding telemetry.

Jordan: rollout to 100% complete at ~2851234578. Monitoring cluster-prod-3. No further OOMs.

IncidentBot: NOTE: incident status -> mitigated (hotfix deployed). Continued monitoring for 2h recommended.

Maya: customer impact: AcmeCorp latency back to normal, SRE alerted and CS emailed with incident summary. No data exfiltration, only availability.

Alex: quick post-deploy checks — heap/kv health, reuse hit rates, and batch-size distribution. Also schedule a canary of tokenizer change in staging with synthetic prefixes to verify prefetch signals.

Liam: creating followup tickets: 
- KVCACHE-472: add unit/regression test for prefix reuse telemetry (assignee: Liam)
- KVCACHE-473: enforce continuous_batch_cap in runtime config (assignee: Samir)
- KVCACHE-474: model-variant-specific prefetch profiles (assignee: Maya)

Sophia: handing off to overnight oncall Jordan -> Jordan are you OK to take until 06:00 PT?

Jordan: taking handoff. Will run additional checks every 30m for first 2h, then hourly. Handoff note: hotfix deployed, canary metrics stable, customer notified.

Samir: +1 to handoff. Adding runbook link and quick rollback commands in the handoff note.

Alex: thanks team. Postmortem draft please include timeline, contributing config changes, and at least two engineering actions (tests + ops safeguards).

IncidentBot: INCIDENT CLOSED -> mitigated -> followup: create postmortem within 72h.

DeployBot: completed pipelines and recorded deploys: hotfix/kv-prefetch-cap @ c0ffee9 -> deployed by Jordan.

Jordan: final note for oncall: watch for any regressions on mistral-7b-gqa where prefix folding is less common; if we see new prefetech spikes, revert tokenizer change in canary.

Maya: adding that to the runbook. 

Alex: end of thread.
